title: Scriptural
summary: SCRIP'TURAL, adjective [from scripture.] 1. Contained in the Scriptures, so called by way of eminence, that is, in the Bible; as a scriptural word, expression or phrase. 2. According to the Scriptures

inlines.v: SCRIP'TURAL, adjective [from scripture.] 1. Contained in the Scriptures, so called by way of eminence, that is, in the Bible; as a scriptural word, expression or phrase. 2. According to the Scriptures or sacred oracles; as a scriptural doctrine.
